title: Home practical guide and safety card: evaporating salt water
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Changes of materials and animals including humans
source: Written for science/y5 lesson 20 (Home practical guide and safety card: evaporating salt water (portal worksheet; warm tap water only, do not taste))
intro: Lesson 20: Reversible changes: dissolving and evaporating. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To get salt back from salt water by evaporation
safety: Warm tap water only, do not taste
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Stir two spoons of salt into half a cup of warm tap water until it dissolves
Pour a thin layer onto the saucer
Leave it on a warm windowsill for two or three days
Look every day with the magnifying glass

questions.q: Big question: how could you get the salt out of sea water?
questions.a: Evaporate the water; the salt is left behind.
